description: Synthetic-but-realistic Claude Code 2.1 request BODY shape for the Anthropic Messages API (GID-006, facts.go). Deliberately kept in this bodies/ subdirectory rather than alongside claude-code-2.1/'s own path-and-headers fixtures: TestGW012EveryFixtureUnderTestdataIsRecognised (harness_test.go) walks only the *.json files directly under a version directory and expects each to be that {method,path,headers} shape, and a subdirectory is skipped rather than descended into -- so this file cannot masquerade as one of GW-012's own recorded shapes. There is no recorded body to pin here either way: the spike (docs/decisions/model-gateway-spike.md) never captured one, only that a brief and a subagent prompt were visible in it. Every value below is invented for this fixture, including the working directory, which is never a real path of any machine. It exercises three things facts.go reads from a request body: the harness's own environment statement ahead of the human's own first message (source of RequestFacts.WorkingDirectory), a <system-reminder> block that must be stripped from RequestFacts.Brief, and a first assistant turn carrying a tool_use whose result comes back as a tool_result (RequestFacts.ToolResultIDs).
